description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Bailey Zappe was released by the Jets on Saturday.
items.impact: Zappe had been competing with fourth-round pick Cade Klubnik and second-year pro Brady Cool for the Jets' backup QB spots behind Geno Smith. Zappe will now look to catch on with a different team.
items.title: Bailey Zappe released by Jets

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Quinn Ewers has been traded to the Jacksonville Jaguars for a 2028 Day 3 pick swap.
items.impact: This feels like a vote of confidence in Malik Willis for Miami's side of things, as Ewers was their starter for a few weeks last season and wasn't all that bad. As for the Jaguars, it looks like they're trying to secure someone they can have confidence in as a backup behind Trevor Lawrence.
items.title: Quinn Ewers traded to Jaguars

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Brett Rypien is likely to be released by the Texans.
items.impact: Rypien is currently the third quarterback on the roster, so the team is rolling with CJ Stroud and Davis Mills. Don't be surprised if they bring back Rypien as an emergency third QB, however.
items.title: Brett Rypien likely to be released by Texans

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ambry Thomas has been released by the Philadelphia Eagles.
items.impact: The veteran corner last played in 2023 with the 49ers and has been trying to find his way back onto the field since. He will have to continue his search elsewhere.
items.title: Ambry Thomas released by Eagles

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Corey Kiner has been traded to the New England Patriots for a seventh-round pick. In a corresponding move, the Pats released Hassan Haskins.
items.impact: The trade for Kiner is interesting. While the cost to acquire is minimal, you would think given the Patriots depth at running back at this point in the season, they'd be trading for Kiner based on special teams usage. But, he was barely used in that department by Arizona last year and all throughout college. He's not a receiving specialist; in fact, you could say he was the opposite. So the move is puzzling, but we will have to see how they plan on deploying the former Bearcat.
items.title: Corey Kiner traded to the New England Patriots

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Hassan Haskins has been released by the New England Patriots after the team traded for Corey Kiner from the Cardinals.
items.impact: Haskins will look to find a new home elsewhere, though his chances of making a roster are slimming by the day.
items.title: Hassan Haskins released by Patriots

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Bobby Okereke signed with the Panthers on Saturday.
items.impact: The Panthers were looking to add some veteran experience at the linebacker spot, and they did just that with Okereke. The 30-year-old is entering his eighth NFL season. Okereke started all 17 games for the Giants last season, racking up 143 total tackles with two interceptions and one sack.
items.title: Bobby Okereke signs with the Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos coach Sean Payton said WR Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the Broncos final preseason game.
items.impact: Mims avoids a serious injury. He is expected to be fine with just a couple of weeks until the season.
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. suffers bruised foot

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills released WR Mecole Hardman Jr.
items.impact: Hardman appeared in only two games with the Bills last season. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Mecole Hardman Jr. released by Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said he is hopeful WR Emeka Egbuka will be available Week 1 against the Bengals.
items.impact: Egbuka has been working his way back from a toe injury during training camp. He is a WR2 with WR1 upside when healthy this season for fantasy managers.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) hopeful for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said he expects WR Jalen McMillan to be available for Week 1 against the Bengals.
items.impact: McMillan has been battling through knee and leg injuries during training camp. He is expected to compete for the immediate WR3 role for Tampa Bay.
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) expected to be available Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alec Pierce went through pregame before Saturday's preseason game against the Lions.
items.impact: Pierce was activated from the PUP list earlier this week. He has a chance to be ready for Week 1 against the Ravens.
items.title: Alec Pierce goes through pregame, not playing

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II remains on track to be good to go for Week 1 against the Broncos.
items.impact: Mahomes has worked his way back from a torn ACL. He didn't see any action in the preseason, but he is expected to be good to go for the season opener.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) on track to start Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks claimed OL Kellen Diesch off waivers.
items.impact: Diesch was previously waived by the Chiefs.
items.title: Kellen Diesch claimed by Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DB Christian Izien is dealing with an undisclosed injury and might not be available Week 1.
items.impact: It is not a long-term concern for Izien.
items.title: Christian Izien (undisclosed) might not be available Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed CB Kenneth Harris.
items.impact: Harris will compete for a depth role in the Colts secondary.
items.title: Kenneth Harris signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed RB Coleman Bennett.
items.impact: Bennett will add depth in the backfield for Miami.
items.title: Coleman Bennett signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks placed Bud Clark on injured reserve.
items.impact: Clark will miss his entire rookie season after suffering a broken ankle.
items.title: Bud Clark (ankle) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders released Foster Sarell.
items.impact: Sarell will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Foster Sarell released by Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed LB Damone Clark on injured reserve.
items.impact: Clark is likely to miss the entirety of the upcoming season.
items.title: Damone Clark placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions signed OL Gus Hartwig.
items.impact: Hartwig will add depth on the offensive line for Detroit.
items.title: Gus Hartwig signs with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers and Xavier Thomas reached an agreement on an injury settlement.
items.impact: Thomas had reverted back to IR. He'll be able to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Xavier Thomas, 49ers reach injury settlement

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets waived Cade York.
items.impact: York will figure to seek another opportunity at some point before or during the season.
items.title: Cade York waived by Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed WR Ryan Miller off waivers.
items.impact: Miller was waived by the Giants earlier in the week. He'll add depth in the wide receiver room for Miami.
items.title: Ryan Miller claimed off waivers by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed DE Ron Stone Jr.
items.impact: Stone will compete for a depth role on the Broncos defensive line.
items.title: Ron Stone Jr. signs with Broncos
